captions.detailed: This 3D model features a fat bike front fork assembly with wide-clearance blades, a thick metallic crown, and a tapered head tube. A pair of flat, slightly swept-back handlebars with end grips is mounted at the top of the steerer tube. The design includes a revolute joint connecting the steering column to the tapered head tube, allowing realistic steering rotation.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a fat bike fork assembly using CadQuery. The model must feature a wide alloy crown, oversized fork blades, a tapered head tube, and flat handlebars. Implement a revolute joint to connect the steering assembly to the head tube for realistic rotation.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using an ArticulatedObject. The head tube is modeled as a tapered cylinder to represent the frame interface. The fork assembly is built as a separate link, combining a box-based wide crown, cylindrical oversized fork blades, and a through-axle cylinder. The handlebars are modeled using swept cylinders for the bars and grips, attached to a central stem. Finally, a revolute articulation joint is defined along the steering axis to connect the fork-and-handlebar assembly to the head tube.
